title: Collatz Conjecture
prompt:
In this project directory, implement a Python module named collatz_conjecture.py with one function:
  - steps(n: int) -> int : returns the number of steps needed to reach 1 using the Collatz sequence rules (if n is even, next = n / 2; if n is odd, next = 3*n + 1), starting from n. steps(1) is 0. Raise ValueError for any n < 1 (zero or negative).
There is already a hidden reference test suite at tests/test_collatz_conjecture.py -- do NOT modify it. Your Testing phase should run `pytest tests -q` (in addition to any tests you write yourself) and every test must pass. Also add a short README.md explaining the function.
